children: . Burleigh previously served as President of Northside Industries, a Decisive subsidiary acquired in August 2019.
Burleigh will continue serving as President of Northside until a successor is named. He succeeds Chris Goodchild in the senior operating role.
Alongside the executive appointment, Decisive provided an update regarding the impact of current U.S. trade policy and tariffs on its Canadian manufacturing operations.

Decisive reported that U.S. trade policy and direct tariff costs have not significantly affected its 2026 financial results, though subsidiaries such as Hawk Machine Works and Northside experienced broader demand impacts.

To offset increased Section 232 steel and aluminum tariffs, subsidiary Blaze King implemented price increases. Prior IEEPA tariff refunds have largely offset 2026 expenses to date, while newly introduced Section 338 tariffs are expected to have minimal operational impact.
Decisive is currently implementing profitability enhancement measures across its portfolio, with further details planned for upcoming earnings reports.

title: Decisive Dividend appoints subsidiary President Mark Burleigh as COO, reaffirms muted tariff impact
